title: Admin activity chronicle and immutable-hash anchoring for audit evidence
creator: Lena Zhang
description: Create a reliable, residency-aware admin activity chronicle that records admin actions, privileged access events, and configuration changes into an append-only evidence store with cryptographic anchoring and automated reporting hooks. The chronicle should support regional data residency tags, retention enforcement, and efficient verification flows for legal/compliance requests without requiring manual bundling.
background: Current admin/audit captures are split between service logs (ELK) and ad-hoc DB records. There is no single tamper-evident export for admin actions and config changes that meets regional residency + retention policy constraints. Compliance teams currently perform manual exports and checks for subpoenas and auditors, which is slow and error-prone. We need a developer-friendly ingestion shape, an immutable backend export path (append-only storage with object-lock semantics), and an automated evidence generation + verification API.
acceptance_criteria: Ingestion API accepts structured admin events (actor, target, action, before/after, request_id, region_tag) and returns an immutable event_id instantly
Events are stored in an append-only evidence bucket with object-lock/GOVERNANCE semantics or equivalent append-only ledger per region

Each evidence blob is cryptographically hashed; daily Merkle roots are computed per-region and anchored to a long-lived signing key (HSM-backed) and optionally anchored to a public blockchain anchor for non-repudiation
Retention rules can be applied per-region and per-event-type; retention enforcement runs without human intervention and logs enforcement actions

A two-endpoint verification flow: (1) generate_evidence_package(region, time_range) that returns a signed manifest and download URL, (2) verify_manifest(manifest, signature) that validates hash chain and residency
Console prototype shows an "Admin Chronicle" viewer with filters (actor, action, resource, date, region) and export button that triggers evidence packaging job
End-to-end test simulates config change, admin revoke, and subsequent verification returns cryptographic proof and matching payloads
tasks: Design: event schema for admin actions including minimal PII footprint and residency tag (Confluence: /display/INF/Admin+Chronicle+Spec)
API: implement /v1/admin-events.accept and event_id generation (idempotent by request_id)
Storage: provision per-region append-only buckets with object-lock or an append-only ledger layer; add lifecycle hooks for retention enforcement
Hashing/Anchoring: implement daily Merkle root job, integrate with KMS/HSM for signing, and create anchoring worker (optional public-anchor toggle)
Evidence API: implement create_evidence_package and verify_manifest endpoints and documented client flows
Console: build Admin Chronicle viewer with server-side filters and export orchestration; wire export to create_evidence_package
E2E test suite: tests for ingestion -> storage -> anchoring -> package -> verify
Runbook: write audit response runbook for legal/compliance teams with examples and SLA expectations
